theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) (f : X → Y) (h F : X → ℝ≥0∞) (A Z : Set X) (B : ℕ → Set X), (∀ m, B m ⊆ A) → Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint B) → (∀ m, NullMeasurableSet (B m) μ) → (A ⊆ Z ∪ ⋃ m, B m) → μ Z = 0 → ν (f '' Z) = 0 → (∀ m, AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ B m ∧ f x = y}, h x) ν ∧ ∫⁻ x in B m, F x ∂μ = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ B m ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂ν) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x) ν ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, F x ∂μ = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂ν
